result.finding: Docker is the container engine used for both local development and deployment. Docker CLI commands are used in build scripts to run infrastructure containers, and Dockerfiles are dynamically created by the deployment script and pushed to Azure Container Registry.
evidence: scripts/startapp.sh: uses 'docker run' to start PostgreSQL and RabbitMQ containers
scripts/stopapp.sh: uses 'docker stop' and 'docker rm' to remove containers
scripts/deploy-to-azure.sh: dynamically generates Dockerfiles for web and worker modules, uses Azure Container Registry (ACR)
README.md: lists Docker as a required prerequisite and describes containerization as a workshop step
values: Azure Container Registry (ACR) used for image hosting
No docker-compose.yml present; infrastructure containers started via individual docker run commands
